name: Automate Attention ArtGenerator
description: Generates the SVG art for Automate Attention tokens across 23 types via three sub-generators.
about:
## ArtGenerator

The SVG art engine for the **Automate Attention** NFT collection (`0x12fd3db5ae10615873a4eadbe4085d0698965139`). The collection's Renderer (`0x6e8f02f70939ad8fa1497c6b3be5007c9100384e`) calls it while assembling each token's metadata.

Given a seed and a market-state prefix, it picks one of 23 art types from a per-state pool and dispatches to the sub-generator that owns it:

- **ArtGenA** (`0xd1f1d32aada5d09c602cf87e69d1d6d4fa6fa520`) — types 0–7 (Grid, Progression, Chart, Concentric, Binary, Arrows, Bars, Maze).
- **ArtGenB** (`0xa181e023e476a759f2423f02d61713db606fb45c`) — types 8–15 (Staircase, Mini Charts, Subdivision, Cascade, Wave, Network, Radial, Balance).
- **ArtGenC** (`0x368934224d01230de6d6005fce4fe85ab37cee8c`) — types 16–22 (Parallel, Fade, Bubbles, Rising Arrows, Orbit, Spine, Half Circles).

It returns the SVG elements plus the chosen type name. All functions are read-only.
